decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any road traffic sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as otherwise to render hazardous the use of any highway railway, waterway (including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 7 - The fascia signs shall be static only, with no moving or apparently moving images, devices, wording or emblems or changing light patterns.
Condition : 8 - Lighting levels shall not exceed levels set out by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Light Pollution.
description: Installation of internally illuminated fascia sign with 'BARRATT' lettering to East and West elevation of building
